description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 diffseq: the regions of difference between two nearly identical sequences (336 nucleotide / protein pairs, every -rformat: report and both GFF3 feature files byte for byte). The exact word matches of wordSize symbols (the engine and the minimal non-overlapping set of megamerger) are the regions of identity; the stretches between them are the differences (a difference with length 0 in one sequence is an insertion in the other); with globalDifferences the differences before the first and after the last match are reported too (a start or end that matches by itself is not counted). A nucleotide pair also gets the SNP count and its transitions / transversions. Returns the differences and the program's files: the report in the default format 'diffseq' (7 report tags; reportFormat takes any -rformat or the report qualifiers as typed, e.g. '-rformat table -raccshow'), and the GFF3 files -aoutfeat / -boutfeat. The sequence qualifiers of both inputs (-sbegin1 -send1 -sreverse1 -slower1 -supper1 -snucleotide1 ... and the same with 2, given in reportFormat as typed after the files, e.g. '-sbegin1 20 -send1 200 -sreverse2 -rformat table') are applied as the program applies them: the sequence is cut to the range (positions, lengths and the report numbers refer to the cut sequence, the header shows the original range), reversed sequences are reported on the reverse strand; 260 / 260 runs equal the installed program. Feature-table inputs (GenBank / EMBL with features) are not part of this tool.

globalDifferences.description: Report the differences at the start and the end (diffseq -globaldifferences).

reportFormat.description: The report format (-rformat name) or the report qualifiers as typed after the files (e.g. '-rformat table -raccshow'); default format diffseq.

differences.description: The regions of difference (1-based starts / ends, lengths; a length 0 is a gap).

overlapStart1.description: Start of the overlap in the first sequence (-1: no match).

overlapEnd1.description: End of the overlap in the first sequence.

overlapStart2.description: Start of the overlap in the second sequence.

overlapEnd2.description: End of the overlap in the second sequence.

report.description: The report file text (-rformat, default diffseq).

featureFile1.description: The GFF3 feature file of the first sequence (-aoutfeat).

featureFile2.description: The GFF3 feature file of the second sequence (-boutfeat).

errors.message: Invalid arguments (an empty or unreadable sequence, a word size below 2, a report format the program refuses for the sequence type).
